jobs.title: Brand Manager
jobs.summary: Lead the growth, positioning and commercial development of selected fragrance and beauty brands across Space markets.
jobs.description: Space is seeking a Brand Manager to steward selected fragrance and beauty brands across regional markets. The role connects brand strategy with disciplined local execution, retail relationships and long-term commercial growth.
responsibilities: Own annual brand plans, launch calendars and commercial targets
Coordinate retail execution, marketing activity and partner reporting
Monitor sell-in, sell-through, inventory and market performance
Protect each brand's positioning and presentation across channels
qualifications: Relevant brand management experience in fragrance, beauty or luxury
Strong commercial, analytical and presentation skills
Ability to work across markets and stakeholder groups

jobs.title: Sales Executive
jobs.summary: Develop retail relationships and deliver thoughtful sales execution for Space's fragrance and beauty portfolio in Kenya.
jobs.description: Space is seeking a Sales Executive to develop trusted retail relationships and support the distribution of international fragrance and beauty brands in Kenya.
responsibilities: Manage an agreed portfolio of retail accounts
Build sell-in plans and maintain accurate sales forecasts
Coordinate launches, product availability and in-store execution
Share structured market and competitor feedback
qualifications: Relevant sales experience in beauty, fragrance, FMCG or luxury retail
Organised, accountable and comfortable working in the field

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.summary: Coordinate reliable inventory movement, order fulfilment and documentation across Space's regional distribution network.
jobs.description: Space is seeking a Logistics Coordinator to support dependable inventory movement, order fulfilment and documentation across regional markets.
responsibilities: Maintain accurate order, inventory and shipping records
Work with warehouses, freight partners and internal teams
Track exceptions and communicate delivery status clearly
qualifications: Relevant logistics, supply-chain or operations experience
Strong attention to detail and follow-through
Confidence with spreadsheets and operational systems

posts.title: Why regional knowledge matters in fragrance distribution
posts.excerpt: International fragrance and beauty brands enter markets with a defined identity. The distributor's role is to preserve that identity while understanding how each retail environment actually works.
posts.body:
International fragrance and beauty brands enter markets with a defined identity. The distributor's role is to preserve that identity while understanding how each retail environment actually works.

Across Africa, markets differ in channel structure, consumer expectations and commercial rhythm. Considered distribution connects those local realities with consistent brand representation, product availability and long-term retail relationships.
